# SeaDek Magnetic Earns Honorable Mention at IBEX


10/01/2024


SeaDek earned an honorable mention at the 2024 IBEX Innovation awards. The awards were selected from over 80 entries submitted by exhibiting marine industry companies.


[Read More](https://marinebusiness.news/news/2024-ibex-innovation-award-winners-announced/)
